assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster texture atlas for a black-and-white engraving musical creature. Reference image is the EXISTING ATLAS: preserve its exact horizontal layout, proportion and transparent cutout, but redraw a NEW ORIGINAL creature. KOREN: massive dark ground serpent, broad blunt head, small watchful slit eye, basalt-like overlapping scales and dense black crosshatching, no horns. One unified continuous side-view drawing of the SAME head, neck and body, no visible seam. Head at left x 0..40%, long straight constant-width body from x 40% to right edge 98%. Mouth faces LEFT and is widely open: upper jaw around y22%, lower jaw around y70%, transparent mouth cavity visible all the way to throat at x16%. Black ink copperplate engraving, exquisite fine irregular scales and stipple, white opaque paper highlights INSIDE creature, no colored pixels. No text, symbols, borders, rings, circular shapes, separate heads, shadows or decorations. Wide 3:1 atlas, high detail, leave transparent margins above/below. Keep anatomical parts inside frame.
